text: About **2.2%** of the property’s area (81.3 hectares out of 3,643.5 hectares) experienced tree-cover loss in 2021. The loss primarily occurred in planted forests (68.1 hectares of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with a smaller portion (13.2 hectares) outside mapped forest areas. The event was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which confirmed 98% of the area as forest in 2020. Additionally, 37.3 hectares of smaller patches (<0.5 ha) were excluded from the total due to the minimum event size threshold.
